BrochureContent.Content:
Dating back to the 1920's, this is one of Dublin's finest residences, idyllically located along the Killiney Shankhill coastline. Select clients will appreciate the location and secluded setting amid nearly an acre of mature grounds.

Boasting lavish interiors throughout, the landmark Dublin property has benefited from substantial investment and planning all the way from 1926 to 2026. 

Seven unique reception rooms offer both scale and intimacy for entertaining, while the leisure area features an indoor heated swimming pool, sauna, steam room, and jacuzzi, providing a private spa escape year-round.

Thanks to its acclaimed design and finishes, this generous five-bedroom, 5-star home offers supreme comfort, and the guest accommodation includes a luxurious principal suite with dual dressing rooms, an opulent ensuite, and a private west-facing terrace.

This 8,772 sq. ft. elegant home offers a rare combination of architectural grace and bespoke amenities. From the sweeping tree-lined drive and grand oak staircase to the Clive Christian kitchen, wood-panelled library, and an oval mood bar and lounge, every detail speaks to craftsmanship and comfort.

Circa 1 Acre
